title: Nelpa Pandita
text: Nelpa Pandita Dragpa Monlam Lodro (Tibetan: nel pa paNDi ta grags pa smon lam blo gros), or Ne'u Pandita was a 13th-century Tibetan Kadampa monk and historian from the Ne'u monastery (奈乌寺). He authored the Ne'u chos-'byung, the earliest known comprehensive account of the political and religious history of Tibet after its integration into the Chinese central realm. In his work, he expressed skepticism toward the Kagyu school and maintained a critical, factual approach to historical sources.
